tools.name: audit_size_chart
tools.description: Checks a size chart and reports what is wrong with it or still unanswered, without changing it. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 64 characters a size label or measurement name; each table cell is r

tools.name: normalise_size_chart
tools.description: Turns a size table, or a chart with gaps, into SizeRef chart format v1 from what the table states plus the answers you pass. Nothing is inferred from the numbers. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 6

tools.name: export_agent_ready_chart
tools.description: Writes a valid SizeRef chart v1 as SizeRef JSON, schema.org JSON-LD, CSV and plain text, and lists anything left out and why. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 64 characters a size label or measurem

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_size_chart · Public sink: audit_size_chart · Destructive: audit_size_chart, normalise_size_chart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_size_chart · Public sink: audit_size_chart · Destructive: audit_size_chart, normalise_size_chart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
